units.source_text: 藏人少将又写信给侍女中将，罄述痛苦之词，

en.t: The Kuroudo Lesser Captain again wrote to the lady-in-waiting Chujo, pouring out words of anguish,

units.source_text: 信中有云：“我命限于今日，实在不胜悲伤。

en.t: and in the letter he said, "My life ends today, and I am overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 但得大小姐一言：‘我可怜你。’

en.t: If only I could receive one word from the elder young lady: 'I pity you.'

units.source_text: 或可赖此延命，暂时生存于世。”

en.t: Perhaps I could rely on that to prolong my life and remain in this world a little longer."

units.source_text: 中将把信呈送大女公子。

en.t: Chujo presented the letter to the elder young lady.

units.source_text: 此时姐妹二人正在话别，相对黯然销魂。

en.t: At that moment the two sisters were speaking of parting, facing each other in heartbreaking gloom.

units.source_text: 往常两人昼夜聚首，如影随形。

en.t: Usually the two were together day and night, inseparable as a shadow from its form.

units.source_text: 邻居东西两室，中间开一界门，犹嫌疏隔太远，彼此常相往来。

en.t: They lived next door in east and west rooms, and even with a dividing door opened between them, they still felt too far apart and constantly visited each other.

units.source_text: 思念今后劳燕分飞，离愁何以堪忍。

en.t: Thinking that from now on they would be separated like birds flying different ways, how could they bear the grief of parting?

units.source_text: 今天大女公子打扮得特别讲究，容姿实甚艳丽。

en.t: Today the elder young lady had dressed with special care, and her appearance was truly radiant and beautiful.

units.source_text: 她回想父亲生前关怀她的前程而说的话，不胜依恋之情。

en.t: She recalled the words her father had spoken while alive, worrying about her future, and was overwhelmed with longing for him.

units.source_text: 正在此时，接到藏人少将的信。

en.t: Just then, a letter arrived from the Kuroudo Lesser Captain.

units.source_text: 她取来一看，想道：“这少将父母双全，家声隆盛，应是幸福之人，

en.t: She took it and read it, thinking, "This Lesser Captain has both parents living and comes from a flourishing house, so he ought to be a fortunate man,

units.source_text: 何故如此悲观，说这无聊的话？”

en.t: so why is he so pessimistic and saying such foolish things?"

units.source_text: 又念信中所言“命限今日”，不知是否真话，便在这信纸的一端写道：

en.t: Then, thinking of the letter's words that his "life ended today" and not knowing whether they were true, she wrote on one edge of the paper:
